name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
source: MERC Order, Case No. 75 of 2025, Summary of LT Tariff for FY 2026-27 (page 53). Electricity duty: MSEDCL Billing FAQs, '16% of (A+B+C+D)'.

bill_inputs.label: Fuel adjustment charge (FAC)
bill_inputs.note: Changes every month. We use the FAC printed on your bill, and ₹0 if it isn't shown.

net_metering.note: Under MERC net metering, extra units are banked for later months. Units left at year end are bought at a low rate, so we count them as ₹0. Residential consumers are exempt from time-of-day banking (MERC Case 75 of 2025, para 35.16).

common_area.note: Housing societies' separately metered common facilities (water pumping, common-area lighting, lifts, parking, fire-fighting pumps) are billed on LT-I(B) Residential, clause (c).
common_area.source: MERC MYT Order for MSEDCL, Case No. 217 of 2024 (28 March 2025), Tariff Schedule, LT I(B) applicability (c) (page 725); para 7.30.13 (page 615): common loads of housing societies are billed at LT I(B) even when supplied at HT.
